company.shortDescription: Double provides an AI career agent that manages job searches, applications, networking, and professional profiles.
company.description: Double provides an AI career agent for managing job searches and professional outreach. The service identifies roles based on a user’s background, tailors resumes and cover letters, and supports application workflows. It also maps potential referral paths, drafts networking messages, manages online profiles, schedules posts, and tracks applications and conversations. Double offers free and paid subscription plans with different usage limits and automation features.

productsAndServices.description: Double AI Career Agent helps job seekers find roles, prepare applications, manage outreach, and track their job searches.
